question: Who holds the No.1 world chess ranking as of June 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**Magnus Carlsen**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Magnus Carlsen**, a Norwegian chess grandmaster, has consistently held the **No.1 world chess ranking** since 2011 in the **FIDE World Chess rankings**. • As of **June 2025**, Carlsen continues to dominate the chess world due to his remarkable skills, exceptional strategies, and unwavering consistency in international tournaments. • Magnus Carlsen became the **World Chess Champion** in 2013 by defeating Viswanathan Anand and has successfully defended his title multiple times since then. • He is known for his **high Elo rating**, which peaked at an all-time record of 2882 in May 2014, showcasing his unparalleled mastery in the game. • Carlsen’s versatile playing style and ability to adapt to different opponents have solidified his position as one of the greatest chess players in history.
